answer: Every message carries a postage stamp priced by the sender's funding lineage. The first account from one source pays 1 unit; the nth pays 1.5^n, so an echo of fifty clones costs about 640,000 units against 1 for an honest user. Stamps are spent into a shared vault and cannot be refunded, and a zephyr of low-volume honest accounts from separate sources never meets the steep part of the curve.
